title: CSV import mangles customer addresses
summary: Our customer import breaks any row with a comma inside quotes (like "Bakersfield, CA"). Rows get split into the wrong columns.
brief: src/csv.js exports parseCSV(text) which must parse RFC 4180 CSV into an array of rows (arrays of strings). Support quoted fields containing commas, escaped quotes (""), newlines inside quoted fields, LF and CRLF line endings, empty fields, and ignore a single trailing newline at end of input. Keep the exported API unchanged.

visibleNames: quoted field with a comma stays in one column
hiddenNames: single trailing newline does not add an empty row
quoted empty string and quoted field at end of line
